  "body_excerpt": "I ideally dont .venv/ folders cluttering my project folders (not the least because they may not be safe to move, at least with `venv`)\r\n\r\nIn my [personal (also rust) workflow tool](https://github.com/dancardin/prp) (that i'd love to not have to maintain if `uv` could arrive at some of the same decisions \ud83d\ude06) there is a setting which when set to \"central\" puts all venvs in `$XDG_DATA_HOME/<toolname>/"
